settings.title: Your dashboard
settings.problemPort: Port 8790 is already used by another app. Turn that off and restart this app.
settings.problemStart: The app could not start. Restart the app; if it stays like this, install it again.
settings.notConnected: No connection to the Homey yet; it is tried again automatically.
settings.failed: That did not work. Try again.
settings.plain: This connection is not encrypted. Only use it on your own network.
settings.noAddress: The address of this Homey is not known now. In the Homey app, look up the IP address at Settings → General → Network, put http:// in front of it and :8790 behind it, and open that on the other device.
settings.intro: A dashboard for your tablet, laptop and phone. This is how you get it on a device:
settings.step1: Put the device on the same Wi-Fi as your Homey.
settings.step2: Scan this code with the camera of that device.
settings.step2Type: Open the address on that device and type in the code.
settings.qrName: QR code to pair a device. The address and the code are below it as well.
settings.expired: This code has expired. Make a new one.
settings.noCameraText: Open this address in the browser and type in the code. If you add the dashboard to the home screen of an iPhone, pair it once more there.
settings.confirm: Unpair __name__? The device will need a new code.
settings.hereText: This only works when this device is on the same Wi-Fi as your Homey.
settings.flowsCard: In Homey, make a flow that starts with the card of Expressive Home: ‘A dashboard button was pressed’. Name the button; it appears on the dashboard by itself.
settings.allFlows: All your flows on the dashboard
settings.flowsWhy: Homey only lets an app start flows with a card of its own. To start other flows as well, you can use a key of your own, also without internet. The key stays on this Homey; the dashboard never passes it on.
settings.flowsStep1: Open my.homey.app in a browser, preferably on this device, and go to Settings → API Keys.
settings.flowsStep2: Make a new key and tick only Start flows.
settings.flowsStep3: Copy the key and paste it below. Homey shows it only once.
settings.flowsConfirm: Remove the key? Then only buttons of the flow card work on the dashboard. The key still exists in Homey itself; remove it there too.
settings.flowKey-none: There is no key. Buttons of the flow card do not need one.
settings.flowKey-works: The key works: your other flows start from the dashboard too.
settings.flowKey-wide: The key works, but may do more than start flows. A key with only the right Start flows is safer.
settings.flowKey-refused: The Homey no longer accepts this key. Make a new one and paste it below.
settings.flowKeyFailed-not-a-key: This is not a key. Copy it again and paste all of it.
settings.flowKeyFailed-refused: The Homey does not know this key. Copy it again, or make a new one.
settings.flowKeyFailed-no-right: This key may not start flows. Make one with the right Start flows.
settings.flowKeyFailed-unreachable: The Homey could not check the key now. Try again.
settings.nightText: With the flow cards ‘Switch the wall tablets to night’ and ‘End the night on the wall tablets’ a flow decides when a wall tablet goes almost black.

flow.notRunning: The dashboard on the Homey is not running now. Restart the app Expressive Home.
